text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Spike in 5xx from ingress-prod (~3.6% -> 18%) starting ~12:34 UTC. Error class: TLS verify failures / client cert verify errors. Affects EU edge and a subset of Dedicated customers. Paging oncall.

olivia: oncall here. I'm looking. seeing a big chunk of 502/526 from gateway logs.

sam: any recent cert rotations pushed? rotator status looks green but last push 12:30.

rotator-bot: rotator deploy accepted (deploy-id: dr-2026-2689). New leaf+intermediate uploaded to vault-eu at 12:28 UTC.

nina: logs from the ingress proxies show: "TLS alert unknown_ca" and "verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate" for incoming mTLS connections.

raj: that's odd — if rotator uploaded intermediate but not the root or chain got truncated, proxies will fail verify. can you paste the s_client output?

olivia: attaching quick replicator from a failing backend:

```
$ openssl s_client -connect ingress-eu.gateway.redwood:443 -showcerts -verify_return_error
CONNECTED(00000003)
1400... verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=svc-client
   i:/CN=rotated-intermediate
 1 s:/CN=rotated-intermediate
   i:/CN=rotated-root
---
No client certificate CA names sent
---
```

sam: hmm chain looks like intermediate signed by rotated-root, but our proxies expect the previous root fingerprint (thumbprint). rotator-bot logs show root was updated but thumbprint mapping for mTLS verification table didn't update.

rotator-bot: noted. rotator commit 0a1b2c updated root.pem -> vault-eu/roots/current. Previous root saved at vault-eu/roots/previous-0a1b.

nina: impact: customer requests doing mTLS to the gateway are failing to authenticate and getting 5xx gateway errors. Non-mTLS traffic unaffected. Estimated affected customers: 7 Dedicated tenants (EU), 2 hosted apps with strict client auth.

olivia: immediate mitigation options:
- rollback rotator to previous root (vault restore)
- set proxy verify mode to permissive for the edge cluster (reduces security but buys time)
- steer traffic to us-west for affected customers
Which should we do first?

raj: start rollback of rotator (safe) + open ticket with infra. If rollback not quick, switch proxy to permissive for those customer routes.

sam: I'm initiating rollback now: `vaultctl restore --env eu --path roots/current --from roots/previous-0a1b` (running)

olivia: also prepping a traffic-steer plan: add route override for tenant-42 and tenant-77 -> us-west-edge; will push canary to 5% first.

nina: grabbing kube exec on ingress-eu proxies to toggle config if needed. Command:
```
kubectl -n ingress exec -it ingress-proxy-0 -- /bin/sh -c "sed -n '1,200p' /etc/proxy/tls-config.yaml"
```

rotator-bot: rollback completed (commit 0a1b2c reverted) at 12:46 UTC, vault path updated.

sam: rolling restart of proxy config watchers so they pick up restored root. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/ingress-proxy -n ingress` (in progress)

olivia: monitoring metrics now. 5xx rate dropping for the subset — nice. still some residual failures from cached processes.

nina: restarted sticky workers on the EU pool to clear old cache: `systemctl restart ingress-worker-*` on nodes eu-1..eu-4.

olivia: traffic-steer paused, not needed now. canary 5% aborted.

raj: status check — current 5xx back to 0.9% (baseline ~0.8%). No new customer alerts. Will continue 15m elevated-monitoring.

sam: root cause summary: rotator pushed a rotated root that wasn't mapped to the mTLS verification table (thumbprint mismatch). Proxies reject client cert chain -> TLS verify failures -> 502/526. Fix: roll back root and update rotator to also update verification fingerprints atomically.

nina: notes for postmortem: add gating on rotator to ensure verification-table update and a canary with mTLS test suite before promoting root to current. Also add automatic rollback trigger if 5xx spikes >5% in 10m after rotation.

olivia: customer comms: support, please draft message for affected Dedicated tenants summarizing the incident and mitigation. CC infra for follow-up.

sam: creating incident ticket I-2681234567, assigning infra/rotator for 72h action items.

rotator-bot: action created: rotator>ensure-atomic-thumbprint-update (ticket DR-4721).

olivia: thanks team. marking this thread resolved for paging. I'll leave monitoring on; update onpostmortem in 24h.

:note: final state: mitigation = rotator rollback + proxy restarts; root cause = non-atomic rotator update causing mTLS verify fingerprint drift. Next steps = automation & gating for rotations, postmortem doc.
